name: Holstered Replica Ironforge Air Rifle
how: An opt-in shootout toy. It only stuns other players holding the same rifle, and it tracks your hits. Claim it once your account has 15 Legacy Points.

name: Replica Dartol's Rod of Transformation
how: A Forever toy copy of the furbolg-disguise rod. It turns you into a furbolg for 3 minutes. It comes from the Raene's Cleansing quest chain, and one guide warns the final turn-in may take it back.

name: Traveler's Symbols
how: Places a sign for 1 minute. With a written message, the sign lasts an hour and other players can see it.

name: Shen'dorei Windwell
how: Summons a portable Windwell for 15 minutes. It comes with the Skyborne Heroic Pack and the higher packs.

name: Pouch of Violet Dust
how: Earned by watching 4 hours of eligible WoW streams with Twitch linked to Battle.net, from 5 to 13 Nov 2026. Thrown on a campfire, it turns the fire purple and adds an hour to camp benefits for everyone resting there. It only works during the Launch Celebration, which ends in early December, and is then removed.

name: Dwarven Tradeskill Signpost
how: An Alliance crafter's sign that advertises a profession you know for 1 minute. An Advertising License Application from the Azeroth Commerce Authority leads into the quest.

name: Orcish Tradeskill Signpost
how: The Horde counterpart to the dwarven signpost. It shows a profession sign for 1 minute. Its source isn't confirmed.

name: Centaur Banner Deployment Device
how: Plants a banner for your chosen side in the Desolace centaur war for 5 minutes.

name: Everlasting Silvermoon Shimmerwine
how: Pours you a glass of Silvermoon Shimmerwine. Datamined client price is 2g 50s, but the vendor isn't confirmed.

name: Adventurer's Tent
how: A Forever toy listed in the datamined toy list. Its source isn't confirmed.

name: Surfer Shoes
how: Bought for a single coin from Jang.

name: Gordok Ogre Suit
how: Made from cloth, leather and Ogre Tannin. Needs level 55. It's a toy collection entry in Forever.

name: Orb of Deception
how: A classic item that makes you look like the opposing faction. It's a very rare drop from mobs level 55 and up, needs level 54, and counts as a toy in Forever.

name: World Enlarger
how: A classic gnomish engineering gadget that enlarges the world for 5 minutes. The schematic is a rare drop from the Weapon Technician.

name: Snowmaster 9000
how: A classic engineering item that turns water into a snowball. It needs a day to recharge.

name: Steam Tonk Controller
how: A classic item that summons a steam tonk you control. Its Forever source isn't listed.

name: Elune's Lantern
how: A classic item that makes an Elune Stone and needs a Solid Stone. It's a toy entry in Forever. Its source isn't listed.

name: Piccolo of the Flaming Fire
how: A classic novelty instrument, listed among Forever toys. Its source isn't confirmed.

name: Winter Veil Disguise Kit
how: A classic holiday novelty, listed among Forever toys. Its source isn't confirmed.

name: Skyborne race access
how: Unlocks the Skyborne race and the Zephras Isle starting zone. It's the one part of Forever locked behind a pack, since everything else needs only game time.

name: Cerulean Prideclaw
how: Ground mount. You still have to buy the riding skill in-game.

name: Veteran Adventurer's Loyal Companion
how: Ground mount that comes with the Epic Pack and up.

name: Skyborne Housing Decor
how: Decor such as the Handmade Shen'dorei Pillow and Shen'dorei Standard. It works only in modern WoW housing, not in Forever.

name: Forsaken and Human Figurine Decor
how: Housing figurines for modern WoW. The Collection is on sale until 11 Jan 2027 and also includes Warcraft III: Reforged and its Forsaken Kingdom campaign.

name: Cozy Sleeping Bag
how: A world-object hunt with no quest givers. Alliance starts with a note in a burned cart at Alexston Farmstead in Westfall; Horde runs the chain the other way, starting in The Barrens. It goes on through Stonetalon, the Loch Modan dam and Thoradin's Wall. Resting in the bag stacks an XP buff of up to 3% and builds rested XP. It has a 1-hour cooldown.
where: Westfall / The Barrens to Arathi Highlands

name: Student Fodder
how: Comes in the satchel at the end of the sleeping-bag hunt. In SoD it gave rested XP; reports say it restores health in Forever.

name: Sturdy Lunchbox
how: A 12-slot container from the sleeping-bag scavenger hunt, according to the wiki.

name: Chronoboon Displacer
how: Stores your world buffs so you can use them later. The main Forever wiki page lists it as returning but only useful in the open world, since world buffs are stripped in dungeons and raids. The item's own wiki page says it doesn't exist in Forever, so its availability is disputed.

name: Library books
how: Books hidden around Azeroth, now open to every class instead of just mages. Hand them in to Garion Wendell (Stormwind Mage Quarter) or Owen Thadd (Undercity Magic Quarter). Reaching 10, 20 and 25 books unlocks reward quests that offer amulets, rings and a bow or night-light. Mages who turn in a book also learn Study.

name: Comprehension scrolls (Bundle of Scrolls)
how: Mages learn Comprehend Scroll at level 6 and use it to decipher world-dropped scrolls into buffs and cantrips. Study at a library, which costs a Light Feather and can be used once an hour, gives a Bundle of Scrolls.

name: Tarnished Undermine Real
how: SoD currency dropped by high-level dungeon bosses. Spend it with Pix Xizzix on armor, reagents and recipes.
